quotes.text: There's too much risk involved with scams disguised as legitimate services because the developers couldn't be bothered to add 1 or 2 DNS records.
quotes.author: himata4113
quotes.source: Hacker News — Outlook.com is rejecting email from domains without DMARC
quotes.extraction_note: Dry, practical wisdom — 'couldn't be bothered to add 1 or 2 DNS records' is a great shaming-the-lazy line.
